metadata.description: Project tabs for Claude Desktop's Code tab

plugins.name: project-tabs
plugins.description: Pinned projects as horizontal tabs in Claude Desktop's Code tab (macOS): project icons, live session status, one click to a project's last session. Reads Claude Desktop's local session records and Claude Code's running-session files; no network. Optional ⌃1–9 shortcuts build and run a small launchd helper (off by default).
